data.content:
Beard Burn is Lowkey the Modern Day Scarlet Letter

By Anonymous

I liked reading The Scarlet Letter in high school because the idea of Hester Prynne being forced to walk around town with a visible symbol of her sexual promiscuity was a concept entirely divorced from my own existence. Yup, I was the loser virgin with her nose stuffed in a book during lunch hour every day.

But now? It’s not so funny. That scarlet letter is f*cking real and takes the form of a crimson chin. A vermilion cupid’s bow. A cardinal cheek.

If you get down and dirty with a stubbled fellow, the world WILL know for weeks to come. When I showed up for the first week of classes with a particularly concealer-resistant case, I could hear the whispers rippling throughout the lecture hall.

Slut… whore… girl that fucks…

It’s like a hickey but worse. It’s almost entirely unavoidable, unless maybe you wanna smear an obnoxious amount of lube or Vaseline all over your faces first. I haven’t troubleshot that one yet so LMK.

It’s truly a universal issue. “I’m pretty sure my entire chin’s epidermis has been exfoliated off at this point,” said Heather Prin (CAS ‘27).

The Condom Fairy was contacted for an interview but declined to comment on the matter. We also contacted the Vending Machine in the GSU Basement, but it just gave us some beeps and whirrs in response. Not sure if that translates to anything of use— perhaps it’s working on a cure?

BU Medical Campus students have been hard at work in the lab to develop an ointment to strengthen the skin barrier and undo the sandpaper effects of 3-day old stubble. “It’s a phenomenon entirely resistant to every effort we make. We’ve never worked with such a stubborn entity,” said Nar Lee (MED ‘26).

One day, we might be able to love up on less recently-shaven people without being forced to flaunt it for the following weeks to come. In the meantime? Get that Dr. Jart color correcting BB cream and some Neosporin and pray, girl.

data.title: Bringing Back Physical Media: Using Instagram on My Laptop
data.description: Bringing Back Physical Media: Using Instagram on My Laptop By Willa Norvell Zuck, Zuck, Zuck… how did we get here? I'll admit, you had me fooled, once upon a time.
data.content:
Bringing Back Physical Media: Using Instagram on My Laptop

By Willa Norvell

Zuck, Zuck, Zuck… how did we get here? I’ll admit, you had me fooled, once upon a time. When all my friends first downloaded your silly little app and I didn’t know any better. When Jesse Eisenberg and his half Josh O’ Connor half Mike Faist face brought your goofy little Harvard story to life. I trust Jesse, so I said sure. A flick of the wrist and bibbity bobbity boo, Instagram became the belle of the ball in my life.

I can still remember sitting in the seventh grade classroom and feeling the rush of my first post getting four likes. I mean wow, what a time to be young in a world where data privacy didn’t exist. But now the appeal has faded, as most things do, and your pink camera square turned back into a pumpkin just a few weeks ago. I can’t bear it anymore. The Ella Enchanted whiplash of smashing the app every five seconds is exhausting. I’m done. I’m finished.

I’m only using Instagram on my computer.

I have to say, this is about as close to cold turkey as I can get. For one, there is no opening Instagram in class in the chance that my peers will see a Yungblud post or something. Two, I physically am incapable of posting a story because computer IG is extremely underdeveloped. Three, for some reason when I comment on someone else’s stuff, it literally sends them a dm? I am not trying to slide, don’t try to play matchmaker Zuck.

However, the physical media movement is back and I’m proud to be a part of it. So far, all I have been hearing is vinyl this, CD that. To those folks I ask, what do you know about the cold touch of your keyboard as you wind down to a Google Chrome tab? Sure, you can’t take cool photos of yourself looking through albums that you absolutely will not buy. But that’s not the point. The point is that I’m disconnecting myself from convenience in such a spiritual way that I can’t even share it on social media. That’s kinda meta, right? Oop! Meta!

Of course, by the time anyone reads this, I will have certainly redownloaded the app for posting or sharing purposes.

data.title: Should More Men Be Starting Podcasts? I Took on the Case
data.description: Should More Men Be Starting Podcasts? I Took on the Case By Lauren Matz Men have been sharing their unsolicited thoughts with humanity since the beginning of time.
data.content:
Should More Men Be Starting Podcasts? I Took on the Case

By Lauren Matz

Men have been sharing their unsolicited thoughts with humanity since the beginning of time. Whether it’s standing on a soap box in the middle of the town square or sitting their bitch ass in front of an Audio Technica AT875R, they have a lot to say and they’re gonna make sure you hear it. Did the journal factory blow up? According to men, it was never even built.

I did some looking into male podcasts, and as annoying as they are, you can’t deny their influence. If you give a man a microphone… other men are gonna listen and use it to form an opinion. It’s a classic factor of the manosphere. But here’s a thought: what if we formed an elite taskforce of men to start feeding more… correct information into the minds of young, impressionable boys? Here’s some ideas I lined up:

She Comes First: Named after the book, this podcast covers all things Female Pleasure. Since men don’t really read, let’s put it in podcast form for them and hope less women have to suffer through Hopeless Desperate Male Fumbling down there. Listeners can submit new tips and tricks they’ve learned for creating a space where their girlfriends can actually enjoy sex. Maybe if it’s a man saying it, other men will finally listen and learn that just hardcore DJ-ing that shit isn’t really all that enjoyable for women. Or maybe some men will just learn the clitoris exists. Either way, there’s potential for major change here.

Axe That Body Spray: The new hit podcast for fans (and noobs) of male hygiene. Listeners can learn that simply dousing their body in a generous helping of Axe Body Spray is not a replacement for a shower. Each week’s episode might cover a new hygiene topic, technique, or tip: for example, if you use a washcloth or loofah to clean your body and not just your bare man hands, you might be on the way to smelling decent! Life changing stuff. Women don’t have to be the only ones that enjoy pampering themselves!

Auth-HER, Direct-HER, Aut-HER: Pronounced Author, Director, Auteur, this podcast is a must-listen for any man new to the world of media made by women. Each week, the hosts cover a new book, movie, or album by a woman and dissect it. The best part– they know when it’s time to shut their mouths and let HER speak! Suggested segments: Listening to Women (reading reviews of the movie/book/album– but ONLY ones written by women), The BOX Office (studies film industry trends from an feminist perspective), and The Bechdel Test (self explanatory). Also, there’s a woman guest every week just to make sure things stay… on track.

Check that E-Male!: Men’s one-stop-shop for learning how to adequately communicate! No more unintelligible mumbles and “k”s, but rather skills to foster some actual meaningful human connection! Listeners can hear about common mistakes men run into when trying and failing to express their feelings and thoughts– AND learn how to do better! And just in case men are simultaneously struggling with LISTENING, the podcast provides 100% accurate transcripts so they can read along and really internalize the message. Men will be speaking like functioning adults in no time!

So. LMK if any of these ideas stand out– I need funding. I really think we can make a difference here! Now, if I can just find some men deserving of the microphone…

data.title: Observing Lent By Tackling Box On Fridays
data.description: As we all know, Lent is a solemn observance that mirrors the 40 days and nights our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ, spent fasting in the desert, enduring salacious temptations by Satan. As devout Catholics, we must prepare for Easter through a period of repentance, sacrificing earthly pleasures to strengthen our faith in and connection with God.
data.content:
As we all know, Lent is a solemn observance that mirrors the 40 days and nights our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ, spent fasting in the desert, enduring salacious temptations by Satan. As devout Catholics, we must prepare for Easter through a period of repentance, sacrificing earthly pleasures to strengthen our faith in and connection with God.

The three pillars of Lent are prayer, almsgiving, and fasting, and I try very hard to partake. I read the Bible and pray every second I have, in hopes that the Almighty will feel my luscious lips wrapping around his glistening, divine words. I donate every spare penny that comes across my bank account to the local megachurch, so they may build a second waterslide or perhaps a sixth parking lot to amplify the voice of the gospel. After all, “It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter into the Kingdom of God” (Mark 10:25), so g*sh-d*rnit I am going to give those alms!

I must confess, here, though, that I am struggling to fast. Forgive me, DaddyFather, for I have sinned.

Some members of my church are practicing simple living by foregoing animal products entirely, living off the grid, and foraging wild tubers, greens, nuts, and berries to sustain themselves. They only return for service, and I shamefully cannot be within 6 feet of them, as they have not showered since Ash Wednesday and stink like H-E-double hockey sticks. I would normally at least abstain from meat on Fridays, but I need the animal protein for my gains — tofu, beans, and fish won’t cut it.

Others refrain from physical relations, engaging in self-denial and resisting the pleasures of the flesh in the same way Jesus did in his long, hot, thirsty trip through the Judaean Desert with the Devil tempting him at every turn. Which could mean nothing. Unfortunately, there is nothing I love more than mortifying my flesh, if you know what I mean. Pious kneeling at a certain altar is a daily occurrence in my household. Chains and flagellation? Sign me up! I am simply too weak to give up these luxuries.

So I propose a compromise. On Fridays, I will abstain from meat, but in return, I will be permitted to partake in the great tradition of consuming seafood without shame. By this, I mean eating bearded clams. Pearl diving. Licking the beaver. Exploring the coral reef. While you all are busy with teaching a man to fish and feeding him for a lifetime or whatever, I’m spending my time groping for trouts in a peculiar river. Tackling box, if you will.

I would like to end this plea with a prayer, so that we may receive mercy from Christ, our Savior.

Look with favor, Lord,

on your household.

Grant that,

though our flesh be humbled

by abstinence from food,

our souls, hungering after you,

may be resplendent in your sight.

Amen.

data.title: Enrolled in Trade School… Why Is No One Gay?
data.description: Look, we all know we're gonna be unemployed within the next five years. It's just a fact.
data.content:
Look, we all know we’re gonna be unemployed within the next five years. It's just a fact. So yes, I dropped out, sue me. Am I still writing for Pinky? Apparently. So I enrolled in trade school, cause’ can a robot be a plumber? Maybe, but not for the next ten years. Suck on that, losers.

Look, I can weld (maybe I think?? Seriously, it doesn’t look too hard), I don't know. I just enrolled. It can’t be that bad, right?

 Did part of me see the word “Trade” and think “omggg waiiiittttt a school full of DL trade men? And it's not the FTV department in COM? Sign me up.” I was soooo excited y'all I can’t even explain. It's been a hard last few weeks, valentines day and all, and I thought I’d meet someone.

**Also look, the term “trade” was taken from the black queer community and its meaning has been changed by those straight girls who looooove to go to a gay bar and make YOU feel like shit.

The second I step onto the linoleum floors of the entryway, I’m hatecrimed.

Okay so not really but I was just walking to class (Pipefitting 101– guess why I picked it), when I was suddenly knocked into the wall by this dude, spilling my books everywhere.

“What the fuck.”

“I- I’m so sorry” He says, rubbing the back of his neck before frantically collecting the spilled textbooks.

Huh. What a weird interaction.

The second I walked into the room, I knew I’d made the wrong decision. It smelled like onions. Man B.O from years of manual labor coated my nostrils in a putrid patina that still refuses to leave. The air was thick with testosterone and repressed self-loathing.

This was the straightest place I’d ever seen.

Instant fight-or-flight reaction. I turn to leave when the man who’d ran into me shuts the door.

Wait- is he my teacher? Is this some Webtoon or Tumblr bullshit I would’ve thought was a literary masterpiece in middle school? If that’s the case, then there has to be a gay side plot.

Apparently, yes. It is.

Class starts, and I’m actually not half bad at this stuff! The professor goes to assist the guy next to me — his work looks like shit from a butt.

“You just need to relax, Will,” The teacher said, placing his hands on top of his student’s; he was slowly guiding his movements as he worked up and down the pipe. “It’s a tight fit”

Okay now actually what the fuck. That’s freaky, right? That’s a freak thing to say? Maybe I’m the friend that’s too woke. I keep working.

“I-I’m not sure if I can do it,”  the student breathes.

Okay woah. Maybe ts is gay. The teacher is sensually welding like in the movie Ghost. That’s gay as hell!

So maybe this was a love story, just not mine.

I mean, come on. My next class is Woodworking… WOOD! The pieces all start to fit in my mind… maybe these Trade School people are actually Trade School Trade? What if you get Trade School Trade take a trade class? I’m a background character in Trade School Musical 2. I’m Sharpay and they’re about to sing “I Don’t Dance” — the gayest song in the series.

I smiled to myself, knowing I’d found my forever home in a sour-smelling paradise of semi-gay dreams.

Life is good.

  • Finding love?
  • Sensually teaching welding
  • WOODWORKING (tap into itttt)

data.content:
seX-Files

Agent NEMO COX

Case Name: “Metrosexual Humanoids”

Case Number: DL-001

Opened: 10.29.25

Closed: 2.28.26

Mission Status: APOCALYPTIC

Agent Status: TERMINATED

Case Log

10.29.25

It all started with these Arcteryx beanies off the ski slope. That must’ve been the point of first transmission. Too much design for your average John. They started lining Commonwealth Ave like a black and purple river rising. Facial and double ear piercings followed shortly after, paired with totes and rings. Each man seemed to know if they were “gold or silver toned.” I know Boston was a gay man's city——but not a gay man only city. Something is up…

11.22.25

Just attended a campus event with no queer undertones but it looked like a Sniffies convention, lined with twinks and trade, trimmed and [REDACTED]. The event was sponsored by some corporation with a French name, “de Pop,” handing out free paraphernalia for every man who signed up for their app. I should’ve known the stylistic French were behind this craze. What straight man hasn’t heard the name Timothee Chalamet praised by mouths of a girl they like—so of course the collective unconscious of 20 year old men would jump at the Parisian promise of panache. These men have found new ways of transmitting older, gayer style.

Also sponsoring this event was the energy drink company, Celsius, handing out pre-mature cardiac arrest in canned form. It would have gone unnoticed as these energy drink companies target any student, specifically student athletes. However, from their booth bedecked in a harsh yellow and red contrasted signage, a young voice shouted “Come feel the RUSH.” I had enough. I left.

02.03.26

Winter break welcomed a swarth of new TikTok shop Christmas gifts bought by girlfriends for their evergrowing-effeminate boyfriends. I see Subject 001 in the library, wrapped in the same gilded-leafed scarf I’d seen him in at the campus event last semester. The sight is dizzying, too many signs and symbols flipped inside-out. Signs and symbols used to mean something more than simple “self-expression.” We’ve come so far as a society only to go, ultimately, nowhere. I digress.

The man, something of my fancy, talked like he had learned more from his mother than he ever did from his father. The man, whom my eye lingered longer on than the other humanoids, seemed like he could be true. The man, who had now conquered my full attention, was reason enough for a full fledged bivestigation. This is no joking matter. I knew there was a protocol somewhere in the gay man handbook about this, even though I’ve never had to use it yet. There has never been a reason to launch such an inquisition where I’m from. Divisions were clear. You either were, or weren’t. Cultural signs and symbols, while restrictive, were respected and served a purpose within the community. None of this Harry Styles shit.

I approached him and complimented his Basquiat shirt. He pulled out his wired headphones (Note: an Airpods case was on the table), and I could see on his home screen he was listening to Joni Mitchell. I see from his laptop stickers he listens to Joanna Newsom and Jane Remover. Did I find the one, or have I met my mortal enemy? In the case of the latter, I should probably brush up on our termination protocol. Either way, Subject 001’s bivestigation remained inconclusive after our intense conversation about Maria Abramovic ended.

02.14.26

Subject 001 found reading “Just Kids” by Patti Smith on a bench outside of COM two days ago. Today the subject was also seen working on a “Robert Mapplethorpe installation report” for his PR class. Hmmmmmmm. Walking slowly behind him in the COM lounge, I scanned his browser tabs for key terms like “John Waters” or “Grace Jones” that could possibly validate my hypothesis. All that was revealed was a de Pop order for birkenstocks and his Keith Haring desktop background. I started to lose hope in my hypothesis that day. If the French got to him, he might be too far gone. The diagnosis is undeniable at this point: a new STD (stylistically-transmitted disease) is spreading across the male population, turning them into irresistible Metrosexual humanoids. And yet somehow I’m the only true victim of this development.

02.28.26

When I mistook the BU tour groups for gaggles of gals and gays who just left Drag brunch, I knew it was too late. My time in Boston is limited. I didn’t think I’d be throwing in the towel at age 20. But these new gens, goddamnit, and their FYPs evergreen with recycled gay fashion trends, have created a hive mind too thick for my Gaydar. When geophysicists say one day the poles will switch and all our electronic devices and compasses will be rendered useless, I did not think they meant those kinds of poles. And I’m here to report: they’ve switched, as evident in my obsolete Gaydar.

I believe there is hope for our underground operation! We can resist, but it will take the utmost coordination and the unfortunate expulsion of our beloved hags! We must get offline as the algorithm muddies the waters! Embrace tradition, comrades, and reject this wretched modernity! Resort back to the hanky code if need be! I wish you all the best, but it is now my time to go. As I die, let this be my bee-stinger lodged into the forearm of a beastly society.

BALENCIAGA!!

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Editor’s Note: This case has been deferred to Agent LIZ BIEN, Agent NEMO COX’s closest confidant, until future development as current conditions are too precarious. The department holds COX’s work with the highest regard, and his contributions to the field are undeniable.

data.title: MUNA, HAIM, and Other Proof of the ABC Mafia
data.description: MUNA, HAIM, and other proof of the ABC mafia By Molly Doherty Listen. I, too, used to feel the hair on my arms raise at the mention of the alphabet mafia.
data.content:
MUNA, HAIM, and other proof of the ABC mafia

By Molly Doherty

Listen. I, too, used to feel the hair on my arms raise at the mention of the alphabet mafia. I, too, used to associate it with the conservatives. I actually can’t even think the phrase without hearing the grating drone of Tucker Carlson.

But lately I’ve been thinking (wow!), and, I’m like, lowkey… I’m starting to see it. The letters, there’s so many letters. They’re EVERYWHERE. Everywhere… the gays are… You guys haven’t noticed?

It all started with HAIM. I was listening to “Gasoline” and was like damn, so many sapphics listen to HAIM, haha. Alphabet mafia, am I right, haha. But no. I suddenly stopped laughing. Something was off. I got out my corkboard and unfurled the red string I usually reserve for explaining conformity gate.[a]

ABBA? All letters, and A and B are literally the beginning of the alphabet too. Okay, so it all starts with ABBA. ABBA does bring to mind a gay-club-70s visual, so I see it. And Mamma Mia! is like the one of the gayest things I can think of.

Then I realized MGMT was a part of it too. Wait, hear me out. They have that one song about Mike and Will from Stranger Things. (Wait guys this is crazy the song came on shuffle while I’m writing this is byler endgame?)

And then I had my big one. I realized who the head of the hydra was, the one behind it all.

MUNA.

A band that puts the WOW in woman-on-woman—sorry I meant WLW. Every time I listen to their music it’s like a spell. I feel like the fruity little bitch I was meant to be. When I saw them live at All Things Go (before they let performative males in rip), their set was titled Lesbopalooza. The mafia is real, and they’re the boss. The gateway drug to a life of U-hauls and carabiners.

All of these acronyms? As queer as your english teacher with “his wife and kids.”

So, maybe they were right all along. There’s a first time for everything.

[a]this is absolutely stunning. no notes.
